fgt_corpus.scope: every fast-growing-trees row in data/prices/<plant>.jsonl for the plants the reference covers
fgt_corpus.reduction: each size cell keeps only price, was_price, raw_size, available; all other row keys dropped
fgt_corpus.scoping_guard: verified at build time that no FGT row OUTSIDE these plants carries a regional size-vocabulary hit, so the union census is unchanged by the scoping

planting_tree_size_labels.scope: every planting-tree row in data/prices/, reduced to its ordered raw_size label tuple with a multiplicity count
planting_tree_size_labels.reduction: 78 distinct label tuples stand in for all 19688 rows; _has_regional_size_vocabulary reads only these labels, so the counts are exact
planting_tree_size_labels.authoritative_for: the dated census quoted in the _REGIONAL_RENDER_RETAILERS comment in scrapers/shopify.py. That comment drifts as the bot appends; these figures are frozen at as_of_commit and are the ones to believe.

regenerate: python tests/fixtures/regional_audit/build_snapshot.py (run from the repo root; reads live data/, rewrites this directory)
